name: 21019-batchdecode-qwen35-35ba3b-tp2
model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, bf16. Public and ungated, ~70 GiB across 14 safetensors shards, already in this machine's HF cache (see env.yaml).
hardware: 2x H100 80GB HBM3 of one a3 node.
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. The checkpoint declares 2 kv heads, so each rank carries one and nothing is replicated.
architecture: Qwen3_5MoeForConditionalGeneration, a sparse MoE with ~3B of 35B parameters active per token; the rest is in the checkpoint's own config.json. The workload is text-only, and the MTP head the checkpoint ships is unused.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup the first 30%, bounded at 600 requests with a 3600 s safety cap. 420 requests are measured.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix: ~256 prompt tokens (stdev 32, clamped 128-512) against ~2048 output tokens (stdev 512, clamped 256-4096), with `ignore_eos: true` and `temperature: 0.0`. About 89% of the tokens are generated rather than read.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant on a 35-billion-parameter sparse model, serving 64 concurrent users short prompts across two GPUs.
launch:
# ENGINE: sglang at the commit named by configs/setupcard.md `commit_id:`, run from the
# interpreter named by configs/env.yaml `venv:`.
#
# Flat `key: value` only -- an indented line is skipped by the reader, so a nested block would
# silently never reach the engine. A bool is a FLAG: `true` emits `--key`, `false` emits nothing.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B
tp-size: 2
max-running-requests: 64

# Every other argument is left at the pinned commit's own default. Do not add
# `--max-mamba-cache-size`: it would cap the running batch that this file pins at 64.
